description.text: The sixth Diamond & Pearl set, released in August 2008 with 146 cards and two theme decks, Bombardment and Metal Surge. It is built around Heatran and Regigigas, and its seven Pokémon LV.X, among them Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf, were more than any set before. It brought Technical Machines back, finished the 28 Unown begun in Diamond & Pearl, and gave a card to the last Sinnoh Pokémon still without one, but for Shaymin and Arceus.
